final: WITH per_gender AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders AS o JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed > '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed < '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_order_count FROM per_gender) SELECT p.gender, p.order_count, p.order_count - a.average_order_count AS above_average FROM per_gender AS p CROSS JOIN avg_count AS a WHERE p.order_count > a.average_order_count ORDER BY p.gender
